en: Old monochrome postcard showing a riverside town with rows of houses along the water and a steep rocky hill behind them. On top of the hill stand fortification structures and a tower, labeled "Schloßberg." Handwritten text and a date appear below the image. The printed caption on the bottom left reads "Graz" with a handwritten date next to it, and on the bottom right it reads "Schloßberg."
